snippet.title: Yosei Wars, neoretro arcade platformer coming to #Steam!
snippet.description:
Another day, another... GAME ANNOUNCEMENT! 🥳

We're thrilled to announce the future release of #YoseiWars🦷🧚! A new #GameBoy neoretro arcade platformer coming to #Steam on June 5th 🥳

Made by Nekete Games with #ZGB♥
🌐Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711170/Yosei_Wars

9 out of 10 dentists recommend to wishlist this game!
